data.one_liner: Icon font with 2,600+ handcrafted icons in Outline and Filled weights
data.what_it_does: Provides a single TrueType font and generated Dart constants for over 2,600 icons. Icons are available in both Outline and Filled styles and can be used with Flutter's Icon widget.
use_when: You need a large, consistent icon set without pulling many separate packages
You prefer compile‑time constants over runtime asset loading
You want both outline and filled variants of the same icon set
avoid_when: You need vector SVGs for custom scaling or manipulation
You require icons that change color per pixel or need alpha transparency
strengths: Huge icon set bundled in one font
Generated Dart constants enable IDE autocomplete
Both outline and filled weights available
weaknesses: No vector SVGs, only font glyphs
Cannot use per‑pixel alpha or gradients
Requires adding a font file to the project
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and run flutter pub get; no extra build steps needed
